description: The plot illustrates a comparison between Initial Accuracy and Final Accuracy across varying frequencies. The x-axis is labeled "o_pop frequency (x10^4)" and uses a linear scale ranging from 1 to 19, with tick marks at intervals of 2. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. The line representing Initial Accuracy is solid green with square markers outlined in black, and includes vertical error bars. It begins at an x-value of 1 with a y-value of approximately 0.34, rises to a peak at x=5 (y≈0.49), and then declines to x=7 (y≈0.30). It remains relatively steady to x=9 (y≈0.31) before rising to its highest peak at x=13 (y≈0.52). The line then declines to x=17 (y≈0.36) and ends at x=19 with a y-value of approximately 0.41. The line representing Final Accuracy is dashed blue with circular markers outlined in black, also featuring vertical error bars. It starts at x=1 with a y-value of approximately 0.65, increases to x=5 (y≈0.86), and drops to x=7 (y≈0.72). It then rises to a peak at x=9 (y≈0.92), declines to x=11 (y≈0.70), and remains relatively steady to x=13 (y≈0.68). Following this, it rises to another peak at x=15 (y≈0.90), drops to x=17 (y≈0.82), and concludes at x=19 with a y-value of approximately 0.90.
